title: Text: DET Matt Boyd ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Is this stuff about you guys being told to go home?
The National guys saying there was an agreement..ARI, STL players told to go home
No. Don’t believe so. Nothing is mandated. Still learning.
For future reference, if you were to tell me something like that, I’d never use your name on it. Thanks for getting back to me, let me know if you guys are told to go home
It’s not required. But we as players want to stay and get ready to play. Stay ready to play.
Thanks. So they told you guys you can leave if you want or what?
We’re meeting later on together. Gonna get the details
